created_from: dog_reports sample PDFs in this workspace

recommended_output_tables.dog_summary: One row per dog; stable identity, demographics, source metadata, and optional derived latest/ever summary flags.
recommended_output_tables.visit_summary: One row per visit, note, procedure, test date, or discharge date with vitals, diet/exposure context, and body-system exam summaries.
recommended_output_tables.phenotype_events: One row per phenotype assertion using phenotype_dictionary.csv phenotype_id and assertion status.
recommended_output_tables.lab_results: One row per analyte result with value, unit, reference range, flag, specimen, panel, date, and evidence.
recommended_output_tables.diagnostic_events: One row per imaging, pathology, cytology, culture, infectious-test, or other diagnostic event.
recommended_output_tables.medication_events: Medication and supplement context with date/status when available.
recommended_output_tables.procedure_events: Procedures including surgery, dental work, wound/bandage care, vaccination, rehab, and acupuncture.

rules: Do not treat rule-outs as confirmed diagnoses.
Use not_reported for fields absent from a report; do not infer normality from silence.
Use absent only when the report explicitly negates a phenotype.
Use historical or resolved when a condition is described as past or no longer active.
For repeated values, keep event rows and optionally derive latest or ever summary columns downstream.
Retain raw source text and a short evidence quote for audit.
Use OCR with orientation correction for scanned or sparse PDFs before LLM extraction.
Do not export owner phone, address, or owner name in phenotype tables unless a separate consented linkage workflow requires it.
Medication exposure is context; do not convert it into a diagnosis unless the source explicitly states the diagnosis.
